description.p: Voice2Win provides high-quality and fully local speech recognition for freely spoken text via a microphone or smartphone. Voice-controlled actions can be activated easily and conveniently at the press of a key. Optionally, a local AI improves your transcriptions or processes them in any way you like — completely free of charge.

Dictate short or long texts directly into the desired application without any additional intermediate steps. Speech recognition works completely without an internet connection. No voice data is transmitted to external services. An internet connection is only required to download the required AI models.

ul.li: Automatic insertion of spoken text into the active window
Launch programs and open files, folders, and websites by voice command
AI processing and automatic replacement of existing text according to spoken instructions
Voice control via freely assignable keyboard shortcuts
Daily log of all transcriptions, stored locally and searchable
Precise local real-time speech recognition based on OpenAI Whisper, with support for 99 languages
Powerful local AI processing using Google's efficient Gemma language model
GPU acceleration via Vulkan; automatic CPU fallback
Customizable recording indicator and audio signals

description.p: Maximum privacy: no uploads, no sign-in, no tracking, no external AI — all data remains exclusively on your device. The program is completely free and works without hidden subscriptions or in-app purchases.
